name: Where's my sofa? Customer care network
description: A care-desk broker for a made-to-order furniture shop: it classifies each customer message, then answers order status, moves deliveries or opens care cases through a Mule MCP server over the shop's System API.

url.description: Base URL of the sofa-care-mcp app (the broker calls <url>/mcp)

apiKey.description: The x-api-key the MCP server expects. Inject at deploy time, never commit a value.
OpenRouter API key. Inject at deploy time, never commit a value.

OBJECT_STORE_DEFAULT_TTL_MS.description: How long a conversation (contextId) is remembered
